title: OL08-02 Closure Quiescence Certification and Closure Start FK Fix

permissions.reason: The runtime fix is inside the existing OL08 SYSTEM-only closure start path and continues to reuse Core identity.organizations.delete; no assignable product permission is introduced or widened.

frontend.reason: Backend lifecycle certification/fix only; no UI, route, menu, form or browser behavior changes.

database.reason: No model or schema shape changes; the existing execution/event FK is now respected by explicit transactional flush ordering.

notes: OL08-02 began as certification-only and exposed a real OL08-01 FK-ordering defect under SQLite foreign-key enforcement: start() added the parent execution and append-only event before one flush, allowing the event insert to precede its parent. The fix flushes the execution first, then appends/flushes the event inside the same transaction; any event failure rolls back the execution, preserving transactional audit evidence. The certification also proves an open OL08 closure cannot bypass existing OL07 queued pre-start cancellation, running safe checkpoints, final provider handoff blocking, lifecycle-authority fail-closed behavior, suspension-cancelled terminality, or ambiguous in-flight no-auto-retry semantics. No export runtime, destructive cleanup, retention policy or Core tombstone behavior is added.
